title: Fix Flow Text Appearance Colors
description: Flow text does not adjust to appearance — on dark mode it still has dark text. Fix WASM canvas hosts (FlowGraphCanvasHost, WasmEditorSurface, WasmGraphSurface) to sync canvas theme via useCanvasAppearanceSync + syncSessionCanvasTheme + renderFrame(), matching the puzzle/note pattern.
summary: Fixed Flow dark-mode text by syncing WASM canvas themes on attach/session-ready and appearance changes (FlowGraphCanvasHost, WasmEditorSurface, WasmGraphSurface), matching the puzzle/note pattern, and giving declarative UiNode text the text-foreground class so panel copy follows appearance.
